content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Panjab University Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 01-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Panjab University Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Panjab University Research Fellow position is 01-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree with at least 55% marks in any discipline from a recognized University or Institute to be eligible for the Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Fellow post is 35 years. There might be age relaxations for certain categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Fellow position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Research Fellow position at Panjab University?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all necessary documents and send it to the official email address provided in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Fellow position will be based on an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Research Fellow position is a contractual job. The duration of the contract will be specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Panjab University located?
faq.answer: Panjab University is located in Chandigarh, with the pincode 160014.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates receiving scholarships apply for this post?
faq.answer: No, candidates who are already in receipt of any scholarship or grant from any government, state, or private sector are not eligible to apply for this Research Fellow position.
